summary: Read-only audit completed against the requested clean, detached commit. Fourteen feature-ledger findings map representative production paths to existing tests and identify behavior to preserve during library adoption. Tauri and GPUI coexist; documentation, model tests, and packaging specifications do not establish runtime parity. No known failure is marked fixed, and no migration is accepted.

findings.title: Tauri shell: navigate, open dialogs, receive updates
findings.notes: Preserve command registration, payload/error shapes, modal exclusivity, LIFO Escape handling, subscription cleanup and initial state delivery. main.rs:1841–1850 registers domain plugins. shell-bridge.js:374 onward retains optional polling fallback, qualifying the STATE zero-polling claim. Configuration exposes global Tauri and sets CSP null; framework adoption requires explicit capability/security review.

findings.title: GPUI shell: receive live state and navigate
findings.notes: Preserve background-event reduction, channel lifecycle updates, selected-channel cleanup, current-user voice isolation and fatal-auth logout. The E2E harness directly mutates AppState through MockDiscordGateway; its historical 50-journey claim does not demonstrate real-window, network or GPU behavior.

findings.title: Authentication: sign in, restore an account, log out
findings.notes: Preserve token validation/redaction, account-key identity, stale-login generation protection, missing/locked keyring errors, CAPTCHA challenge surfacing, TOTP transitions and logout cleanup. GPUI token_store.rs:21–24 defines active/per-account keys, distinct from Tauri's token key. Mock-backed auth tests do not qualify OS credential storage.

findings.title: REST: perform actions without duplicate side effects
findings.notes: Preserve exact routes, headers, timeout bounds, typed 401/403/404/413/429/5xx errors, retry-after and redacted telemetry. client.rs:492–560 distinguishes idempotent transport retries from HTTP failure policy. Replacement must not blindly retry message-creation POSTs or replace measured wire contracts with library defaults.

findings.title: Gateway: connect, recover and resume state
findings.notes: Preserve connection-scoped zstd context, ETF unsigned Snowflakes, heartbeat/ACK handling, sequence/session state, bounded backoff, IDENTIFY fallback and fatal close handling. Supervisor declares four failed RESUMEs before reset and a 180000ms resume TTL. Local socket tests are not Discord interoperability evidence; massive-guild OP37 tuning remains documented.

findings.title: DMs and friends: open conversations and manage recipients
findings.notes: Preserve READY private-channel hydration, relationship tabs, stranger confirmation, recipient validation and nine-recipient group limit. dm_channels.rs:69–74 emits recipient_id for one recipient; the UI test provenance says POST always uses recipients. Resolve this discrepancy against independent evidence. Home/Friends code exists, but the documented missing-DM journey remains unverified.

findings.title: Guilds: join, browse channels and enforce permissions
findings.notes: Preserve lurker join/leave payloads, 204 success, membership screening, category selection and 64-bit permission ordering: everyone, combined role overwrites, member overwrite, owner/admin bypass. Fixture contracts cover real permission data. Documented delayed/missing channels after partial READY or throttled fallback remain unresolved by this audit.

findings.title: Text chat: read history, compose, attach and retry
findings.notes: Preserve loading/empty/error states, before-cursor pagination, scroll position, optimistic nonce deduplication, failed-draft retry, replies and attachment limits. GPUI tests explicitly cover 2000-character boundaries and HTTP failures. Autocomplete has isolated DOM-shim tests; sampled application searches found no controller invocation. Mention/slash/editing limitations cannot be declared fixed.

findings.title: Voice: join, mute, select devices and reconnect
findings.notes: Preserve voice-state/server-update barrier, negotiation revision, confirmation only after session description, timeout leave cleanup, 74-byte discovery, encryption selection, mute/deafen and recovery telemetry. Tests include loopback UDP and state machines; physical audio, latency and device hotplug remain unverified. Wayland global PTT remains a documented gap.

findings.title: DAVE: retain encrypted media across membership changes
findings.notes: Preserve MLS proposal/commit rejection, epoch transitions, truncated eight-byte tags, nonce/generation wrapping, retained epochs and duplicate/expired packet rejection. replay.rs:6 defines a 1024-packet window. Regression cases address arithmetic boundaries; they do not establish complete MLS conformance or sustained fuzz coverage. Simultaneous-join resynchronization delay remains documented.

findings.title: Screen sharing: broadcast, switch sources and watch
findings.notes: Preserve portal cancellation, FD ownership/CLOEXEC, pixel formats/stride, SHM fallback, source switching, pause/resume keyframes and OP18/19/22 signaling. Pipeline contracts use mock portal/local Unix sockets. They do not qualify desktop capture. Windows/macOS broadcast stubs, single-stream viewing and error-2007 recovery remain unverified known limitations; PLI-related code alone does not close them.

findings.title: Storage: restart safely with cached and protected data
findings.notes: Preserve schema migration, WAL durability, keyset ordering, deduplication, parameter binding and authenticated corruption rejection. GPUI LocalDatabase opens ordinary rusqlite connections; encrypted_store's LinuxKeyringClient uses an in-memory map. Application-wide encryption wiring is not established. Independent Python SQLite and Node crypto oracles exist, but live keyring cases are separate and ignored by default.

findings.title: Accessibility: navigate and operate without a pointer
findings.notes: Preserve semantic roles, localized names, focus, disabled states, keyboard selection and ARIA listbox/tab semantics. AppDriver builds its tree from AppState and records D-Bus wire messages; this does not prove assistive-technology access to a real window. Linux AT-SPI evidence cannot qualify Windows UI Automation or macOS accessibility.

findings.title: Desktop delivery: autostart, deep links and install packages
findings.notes: Preserve Exec escaping, disable-autostart behavior, queued deep links, secret redaction, portable data location and release identity. Autostart explicitly distinguishes generated text/badge models from integration. Packaging contracts do not establish installation, signing or native execution. CP-006 records a previously simulated ARM package and requires genuine Cargo/tool inputs; this audit validates no replacement artifact.

risks: README, PROJECT-CONTEXT and waves/STATE counts, mutation results, parity percentages and old RAM/FPS/startup benchmarks are historical claims, unverified in this phase.
DECISIONS records initial 11 meta and 323 unit failures. Their current disposition requires execution evidence; none is reclassified here.
README reports Windows native compilation blocked by Unix APIs; macOS/ARM GUI runtime remains unqualified. These platform claims were not independently executed.
Legacy namespace and external oracle paths complicate traceability; library adoption could preserve a model while breaking the actual user journey.
next_actions: Coordinator should reconcile the DM payload discrepancy and shell-specific limitations against checked-in clean-room evidence before defining replacement contracts.
Create scoped adoption cards recording current dependency, proposed library, exact wire/storage/UI invariants, independent oracle and affected tests for each journey.
In a separately authorized execution phase, reproduce the current failures first and preserve command, exit code, environment and logs before modifications.
Require native Linux, Windows, macOS and ARM qualification separately, including audio/capture, credentials, accessibility, installation and artifact provenance.
Trace encryption and autocomplete through actual application entry points; add missing integration contracts before claiming those journeys complete.
limitations: Only filesystem inspection and read-only Git metadata queries were performed. HEAD, detached state and clean status were checked; no files were edited.
No builds, tests, applications, agents, services, network calls, credentials or connected MCP services were used.
Representative sampling is not the full parity gate. No LIB-GOV-01 row was found in TASKS.md; the supplied task specification governed scope.
The coordinator must review and persist this report; findings are not acceptance or migration completion.
